description: A plain text prompt through the claude_code adapter, with its fake `claude` reporting its own argv, the prompt it read on stdin, its working directory and every PARENT_SESSION_ENV/DEFAULT_UNSET_ENV name's presence. `CLAUDECODE`/`CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT`/`PI_SESSION_ID` are set via `env`, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` via `fake_credentials` -- all must be absent in the child, with the neutral variable present.
